metadata.title: European Stroke Organisation (ESO) guideline on visual impairment in stroke
top_takeaways: Routine vision screening is recommended for all adult stroke survivors within 1 week of stroke onset to ensure early detection of visual deficits.
Comprehensive screening and assessment protocols should be embedded across pre-hospital, hyperacute, acute, and rehabilitation stroke pathways.

Post-stroke visual management must be tailored to the specific domain of impairment, including central vision loss, ocular stroke (CRAO), eye movement disorders, visual field loss, visual neglect, and visual perception deficits.

recommendations.statement: Vision screening is suggested in all patients with stroke within 1 week of symptom onset to enhance detection of visual impairment.
